proposed_one_shot_workflow_after_indepen: Gate 0: Fresh SSH host-key/UID1000, parent chain O_NOFOLLOW/mode/ACL and new-root lexists=false; old root unchanged and lease/final absent at chosen new names.

Gate 1: Create exactly new real root as UID1000 owner-write-only mode 0755 (not 0700: graph worker nobody needs traversal), control/staging 0700, out/tmp traversable 0755, source-view as needed for host UI build; no symlink to old root. Use O_EXCL/dirfd semantics, fsync, readback. Prove nobody cannot write project parent/control/source.

Gate 2: Generate 46 symlinks from frozen SOURCE-VIEW-LINKS.tsv using approved source-view script; verify literal targets, resolved realpaths, expected HEADs, count 46, no extra entries; do not copy AOSP.
Gate 3: Stage seven exact-byte control seeds and regenerate environment JSON from updated authoritative local_env; verify hashes, modes, paths and new config SHA; preserve old seed byte receipt.

Gate 4: Rebuild or separately admit patched Soong UI and no-namespace guard into new out; verify x86-64 ELF, SHA, worktree/source provenance, no forbidden exec, guard probe. Prove sudo -u nobody can traverse new root/out and execute exact tool, then that nobody cannot write parent/control/shared source; do not reuse old out/tmp/staging.

Gate 5: Freeze new runner/stager/owner-gate generation with new root/config/binding/tool identities, independently static-review and fixture; fresh O_EXCL lease and START before any later graph; full source manifest/HEAD/untracked pre/post guard; no old release replay.
command_templates_scope: Illustrative remote Linux argv only; substitute verified bindings from a newly frozen environment packet. These are not an authorized dispatch script.

mode_design_hard_condition.finding: The prior private-root scout suggested 0700 for the new root, but G279 v7 later executes the UI and guard under sudo -u nobody. A 0700 project root would make both binaries and graph OUT/TMP unreachable by nobody.
mode_design_hard_condition.required: Owner-only write, not owner-only traversal: root and ancestors of tool binaries and graph out/tmp need executable traversal for nobody, for example 0755 with UID1000 and no ACL group write. control may be 0700; staging may be 0700 if no nobody access is needed. Fresh gate must prove nobody can traverse and execute exact tools but cannot write project parent/control/source.
